content: Ambe, emigiro gya Musa ni kireengyo ego kya amangʼana amazomu gano gakuuza ge embere, nawe gatari obhuheene bhwa amangʼana gayo ageene. Nikyo, ebhimweeso bhino abhaatu bhakuruusya mwaaka kumwaaka kutuukana ne emigiro giyo, bhitakutura na rumwe okubheerya abhaatu bhano bhakumuseengera Taatabhugya.

Eraabhe ebhimweeso bhiyo bhiingabheeri bhibheerirye ebhibhi bhyaabhu, bhatiingabheeri bhariiyiigwa mumitima gyaabhu ni bhatemya bhe ebhibhi. Kweeki bhaangabheeri bhatigiri okuruusya ebhimweeso bhyaabhu, kwo okubha bhaari bhamariri okweeribhwa rugeendo rumwe.
Nawe, ebhimweeso bhino bhakuruusya mwaaka kumwaaka obhona bhirabhahiitya ebhibhi bhyaabhu,
kwo okubha amanyiinga ge eziimburi na ge eziigeeni gatana amanaga go okuruusyaho ebhibhi bhya abhaatu.
Kweego hano Krisito akaaza mukyaaro kino, akamubhuurira Taatabhugya,

content.text: nawe ombanuriiri omubhiri gwaane kubha ekimweeso.
Awe otakuzomerwa ne ebhimweeso bhyo okusikya
kasi bhino abhaatu bhakuruusya kwiiguru we ebhibhi.
Niho nikabhuga, ‘Ee Taatabhugya waane! Enye niri hano,
kyeego ekaamirwe mu Makaamo Amahoreeru iguru waane.’ ”

content: Ryo okutaanga Krisito akabhuga, “Awe otakweenda ebhimweeso bhye emitugo, ebhimweeso bhyo okusikya, ebhimweeso kwiiguru we ebhibhi ne ebhimweeso ebhiindi, awe otaazomereerwe nabhyo.” Yiingabha ebhimweeso bhyoosi bhiyo bhaari bhakuruusya kuriingʼaana ne emigiro gya Musa.

Kyaamwe akabhuga, “Ee Taatabhugya waane! Enye niri hano, okubha nibhe nirakora obhuseegi bhwaazo.” Kweego Taatabhugya akaruusyaho ebhimweeso bhye eriiragano ryo okutaanga no okutuura ekimweeso kya Krisito, okubha ariimeererye eriiragano rya kabhiri.
Yeesu Krisito akakora obhuseegi bhwa Taatabhugya, kwo okwiiruusya rugeendo rumwe ego kubha ekimweeso kyeetu. Kwe ekigirirye kiyo, Taatabhugya atweerirye ebhibhi bhyeetu.

Kuriingʼaana ne eriiragano rye ekare, eziisiku zyoosi abhaseengeri bhahaamuseengera no okumuhokeerya Taatabhugya. Bhahaamuruusirya ebhimweeso bhiryabhirya maanga kaaru, bhino bhitaanagirye kuruusyaho ebhibhi naabhe hasuuhu.
Nawe Krisito akiiruusya rugeendo rumwe kubha ekimweeso, okubha atweerye ebhibhi bhyeetu. Ewe ni kimweeso kya kirakeego. Kweego yiikeeri mukubhoko kwo obhuryo ku Taatabhugya.
Ewe ari mwiisaaro eyo, arageenderera okuganya tee hano Taatabhugya abhatuure abhabhisa bhaaye iyaasi wa amaguru gaaye.
Kwe enzira ya Yeesu okwiiruusya rugeendo rumwe ego, abhakuunaanirye abhahoreeru kirakeego.
Ekoro Muhoreeru woosi aramenyeekererya amangʼana gayo kweetwe kwo okubhuga,

content.text: rino niraakore na abhaatu bhaane eziisiku zino zikuuza.

content: Kweeki arabhuga,
Ambe, eraabhe Taatabhugya abhaabhiiri abhaatu ebhibhi, bhutariho obhweendi bhwo okuruusya ekimweeso kweeki.
Tuno obhwiiragaanzi bhwo okugya embere wa Taatabhugya
Abhahiiri bhaane, kwe enzira ya amanyiinga ga Yeesu, etwe turi bhiiragaanzi okusikira Ahahoreeru ha Ahahoreeru okutama okwoobhoha.
Ewe akatwiigurira enzira ehya yo obhuhoru, okubha tubhe turasikira embere wa Taatabhugya kuhitira mumweenda, nagwo ni mubhiri gwaaye.
Bhoono, etwe tuno Omuseengeri Omukuru, wuno akwiimeererera enyuumba ya Taatabhugya.

Kweego, tubhe turagya ne emitima mizomu no obhwiikirirya bhuno bhukuunaaniri, kwo okubha Taatabhugya atweerirye eziikoro zyeetu eziimbi kwe enzira ya amanyiinga ga Yeesu no okutwiisaabhya na amaanzi mazomu.
Tukore omukya bhukongʼu okugagwaatirira gano tukugiikirirya no okugiisigira, kwo okubha Taatabhugya wuno yarageenie, ni muheene.
Kweeki tureenderwa okutoongerana eziikoro okubha tuseegane no okukorerana amazomu etwe kwe etwe.

Tutatiga okwiisaanga hamwe kyeego abhaatu abhaandi bhatigiri okwiisaanga. Nawe tugeenderere okutoongerana eziikoro etwe kwe etwe, kwo okubha tumenyiri kubha orusiku rwo okukyoora kwo Omukuru ruri haguhi.
Eraabhe turageenderera kukora ebhibhi kwe enzabhuro, eno tumenyiri obhuheene bhwa Taatabhugya, ambe kitariho ekimweeso ekiindi kino kikutura okutweerya ebhibhi.
Nawe, kino kikusaaga ni kuganya obhutini bhwe ekiina bhwa Taatabhugya bhuno bhuroobhohya no omuriro guno guraasikye abhaatu bhoosi bhano bhakumwaanga Taatabhugya.
Omuutu wuno yaari akusarya emigiro gya Musa, yaari ariitwa okubhura ebhigoongi, eraabhe abhamenyeekererya bhabhiri kasi bhatatu bhamenyeekereerye kubha, eheene akoriri gayo.

Mwiiseege! Mbe, obhutemwa bhurabha igabhwi kumuutu wuno akumuzeera Omwaana wa Taatabhugya na amanyiinga ge eriiragano gano gakamweerya ebhibhi bhyaaye? Mbe, obhutemwa bhurabha igabhwi kumuutu wuno akumutuka Ekoro Muhoreeru wo orubhaango?
Tumenyiri Taatabhugya niwe akabhuga, “Okuriha ekisiiyoomba ni mirimo gyaane, enye niwe wuno nikuriha ekisiiyoomba.” Kweeki akabhuga, “Enye Omukuru, Taatabhugya nirabhatinira ekiina abhaatu bhaane.”
Engʼana yo okwoobhohya bhukongʼu, ni kutinirwa ekiina na Taatabhugya wuno ari muhoru.
Nawe, muhiite eziisiku zino mukataanga okumwiikirirya Krisito. Yiingabha mwaari murabhona enyaako ekuru, naabhe ego mwaari muriikongʼeererya enyaako yiyo.
Eriibhaga riindi abhaatu bhaari bharabhatuka no okubhagirirya enyaako embere wa abhaatu bhaaru. Ibhaga riindi mwaari murabhasakirya bhano bhaari bhakubhona eziinyaako kya ziyo.

Kweeki mwaari murabharorera ebhigoongi abharikyeenyu bhano bhabhohirwe munyuumba ya abhabhohwa. Kweeki mukiikongʼeererya okuruusibhwa ebhigiro bhyeenyu, na mukageenderera kubha no obhuzomererwa, kwo okubha mukamenya munabhyo ebhigiro bhizomu bhino bhikwiikara kyoomeera.
Kwe ekigirirye kiyo, mugeenderere kubha no obhukaru bhuyo, kwo okubha kwe enzira yiyo murasuungʼaana esaambo ekuru bhukongʼu okurwa ku Taatabhugya.
Mureenderwa mubhe muriigumiirirya, okubha mukore gano Taatabhugya akweenda. Kwe enzira yiyo, murasuungʼaana gano Taatabhugya akaragania okubhaha.
Ekaamirwe mu Makaamo Amahoreeru,

content.text: ariikara kwe ekigirirye kyo obhwiikirirya bhwaaye.
Nawe eraabhe omuutu wuyo aratiga okunituniirira enye,

content: Etwe tutari gati wa abhaatu bhano bhakutiga okumutuniirira Taatabhugya no okubhura. Nawe turi hamwe na bhano bhakumwiikirirya no okutuuribhwa.
